title: Award-Winning Culture: RingCentral Bulgaria Takes Home 3 Career Show Awards
summary: We have big news to celebrate with you!! RingCentral Bulgaria has been recognized across three distinct categories at the prestigious Career Show Awards
body_markdown:
We have big news to celebrate with you!! RingCentral Bulgaria has been recognized across three distinct categories at the prestigious Career Show Awards 2026.


This year, our team brought home honors for:


🥈Silver: Inspiring Work Environment


🥉Bronze: Strategy for Talent Management


🥉Bronze: Innovations in the Workspace


These awards reflect our commitment to fostering a space where top tech talent can thrive, innovate, and feel supported.Being acknowledged by the broader community validates the passion and hard work our leadership and teams bring to the office every single day.


While we’re proud to celebrate these achievements, our work doesn’t stop here. We remain dedicated to building an even stronger, more engaging workplace, and pushing the boundaries of what makes a company a truly great place to grow your career.


A massive thank you to our entire RingCentral Bulgaria team — culture isn’t built by corporate guidelines, it’s built by people, and this recognition belongs to all of you!


Ready to join an award-winning team? Explore our open roles on[the RingCentral Careers page](https://www.ringcentral.com/bg/en/careers.html) .


Originally published Sep 22, 2026
